newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kookmin HK$ FRN seen after GDR issue.
newsitem.headline: Kookmin HK$ FRN seen after GDR issue.

text.p: Kookmin Bank is expected to launch a Hong Kong dollar floating rate note following its issue of Global Depository Receipts, bankers said.
The bank has mandated Merrill Lynch and Sakura Finance Asia to arrange the FRN transaction, they said.
The issue's size, maturity and other terms of the FRN are expected to be set after the GDR issue is completed.
Most bankers expect the notes issue to be at least HK$1 billion in size so that it will be eligible for the Hong Kong Monetary Authority's Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF), or discount window.
Eligibility for LAF makes an issue more attractive to banks because holders of the qualifying debt can engage in repurchase agreements with the monetary authority, increasing liquidity.
Kookmin is expected to offer US$300 million worth of GDR shares later this month.
